items.title: Amos White Interview, 1958-08-23
items.q: I was with Jeff Smith under his direction.

ctx.x: At the old Columbia Theater. I think it was on 47th Street, I don't remember where. Oh, right on Broadway. Yeah. Yeah, I remember.

Yeah, so I took a portion of the band down there, 11 fellas, and we played this Uncle Tom's Cabin production there. Well, then I began to trek around the country with circuses and minstrel shows and so forth. My first minstrel show was the Franks New York Minstrels out of Birmingham, Alabama. In 1914, I went off on a tour with that minstrel show. But the show busted up after coming out through Virginia into Tennessee. They busted up in a little town called Pulaski, Tennessee. And then I taught a little band in…
songs and marches. How big a band did those minstrel shows have?
